THE EMPLOYMENT SITUATION - AUGUST 2026

Total nonfarm payroll employment increased by 123,000 in August, and the unemployment rate was unchanged at 4.2 percent.

Employment in food services increased by 45,000 in August. Local government education added 12,000 jobs in August. Information employment declined by 7,000 in August.

In August, average hourly earnings rose by 8 cents, or 0.2 percent, to $28.50. Over the year, average hourly earnings have increased by 3.0 percent.

The change in total nonfarm payroll employment for June was revised up by 10,000, from +20,000 to +30,000, and the change for July was revised down by 5,000, from +15,000 to +10,000.
